closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, high satiety protein source, and can control hunger well in real meals, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin D, and low omega 3. It is good for muscles and strength sports, low-calorie volume, and blood and oxygen support because the protein section supports repair and maintenance, it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, and vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side.
